title: Wanderburg Captains — Unlock Roles and Build Identity
description: Wanderburg captains explained from Steam meta-progression copy: what captains are for, how they relate to builds, and what is still 待确认 before deep guides.

paragraphs: Steam’s progression blurb lists captains alongside modules, vehicles, and artifacts as between-run unlocks that widen strategic options.
Players searching wanderburg best captain usually want a ranked list. Before EA settles, we only document the role category — not invented captain names or fake tier scores.

sections.h2: How to use captains in practice
paragraphs: Treat a captain unlock as a build identity lever: once you have sustain and a clear damage package, a captain should reinforce that plan instead of fighting it.
Pair this page with Best Build and Unlocks. When official patch notes name captains, update this article with sourced abilities instead of speculation.
As of research day we did not have two independent, detailed captain databases. Anything claiming precise captain DPS tables without a cited patch is likely guesswork.
If Discord or Steam news posts a captain roster, cite it here and mark older paragraphs outdated.

note: 弱源页：仅确认 captains 属于局间解锁类别，无完整官方名单时不编造。
